limits: Every actual screenshot path keeps its own archive identity even when bytes duplicate. Duplicate pending images stay unreviewed until a genuine new review exists.
Prior original reviewer and historical method are preserved. A contact-sheet origin is never called a new original-PNG direct view.
Pixel appearance reuse does not establish this execution semantic PASS, hidden text, current game state, server mechanism or complete project correctness.
Identity metadata is recorded by source JSON pointer and SHA; missing identity metadata is explicit and never filled with a guessed window PID.
